observations: Title: Prenatal zinc reduces stress response in adult rat offspring exposed to lipopolysaccharide during gestation.

entities.name: Prenatal zinc attenuates stress
observations: In Wistar rats, maternal zinc sulfate (2 mg/kg SC) given one hour after gestational-day-9.5 LPS (100 μg/kg IP) was associated with lower serum corticosterone and reduced striatal norepinephrine turnover in adult female offspring after 2-hour restraint, versus LPS plus saline.
Abstract-level evidence from one animal study; the outcome concerns acute restraint response in adult female offspring.
